name: Notehub
description:
Notehub IQ is an intelligence layer for Notehub. For teams already collecting data from deployed products, it removes the last hard step: getting actionable answers out. Rather than building dashboards, exporting data, or pulling in an engineer to write a query, you ask your products a question in plain language and get an answer drawn from the Notehub data you already collect. It works whether you have a hundred devices or a million.

Under the hood, today Notehub IQ is comprised of two Blues-provided components, used with an AI agent you already have:

1. A first-party storage service that acts as the data layer that securely stores and syncs the Notefile data you choose, ready for fast analytical queries.
2. This MCP server called that acts as the interface to Notehub IQ. It turns your plain-language questions into queries, runs them, and reasons over the results.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Notehub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Notehub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.notehub.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Notehub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notehub lists 13 MCP tools, including create_repository_dataset, create_storage_repository, delete_repository_dataset, delete_storage_repository, describe_schema, get_table_sample, infer_dataset, list_onboardable_projects, list_project_fleets, list_project_notefile_schemas, list_repositories, and query_repository.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Notehub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Notehub in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Notehub requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Notehub is developed by Blues Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
